tree.heading: Native American programs
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out section 3221 of this title (not including subsection (k) of such section)—

tree.heading: Migrant and seasonal farmworker programs
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out section 3222 of this title—

tree.heading: Technical assistance
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out section 3223 of this title—

tree.heading: Evaluations and research
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out section 3224 of this title—

tree.heading: Assistance for veterans
tree.text: If, as of July 22, 2014, any unobligated funds appropriated to carry out section 2913 of this title, as in effect on the day before July 22, 2014, remain available, the Secretary of Labor shall continue to use such funds to carry out such section, as in effect on such day, until all of such funds are expended.

tree.heading: Assistance for eligible workers
tree.text: If, as of July 22, 2014, any unobligated funds appropriated to carry out subsections (f) and (g) of section 2918 of this title, as in effect on the day before July 22, 2014, remain available, the Secretary of Labor shall continue to use such funds to carry out such subsections, as in effect on such day, until all of such funds are expended.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Sections 2913 and 2918 of this title, referred to in subsecs. (e) and (f), were repealed by Pub. L. 113–128, title V, § 511(a), July 22, 2014, 128 Stat. 1705, effective July 1, 2015.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the first day of the first full program year after July 22, 2014 (July 1, 2015), see section 506 of Pub. L. 113–128, set out as a note under section 3101 of this title.
